summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the implications of moving away from Slack, particularly regarding chat history retention. It was noted that while a full migration method for historical data is not currently available, switching to a free plan would retain approximately 10,000 recent messages, with the total history estimated at half a million messages.

Regarding integrations and communication channels, there was a discussion about consolidating all existing hooks from various job boards into this current chat platform. The participants agreed on gradually migrating these functions. Furthermore, the team discussed alternative platforms like Microsoft Teams, IRC, and Jabber/XMMP as potential replacements for Slack.
decisions: All existing hooks from various job boards will be migrated to the current communication channel.
The migration of chat history is acknowledged but no immediate solution was found.
action_items: Gradually migrate all existing hooks into this room.
